headline: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
description: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble. The plan brokered under the auspices of the American president on October 10, 2025 has stalled, and despite the ceasefire it provides for, Israel's campaign of destruction has continued.

headline: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay for her efforts to promote international law
description: Pillay, 85, is a former UN human rights commissioner. The Nobel jury said it was honoring her for her 'commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass.'

headline: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
description: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.

headline: Heatwaves killed over 8,000 people in France this year. Here are some of their stories
description: The French health authorities reported that 8,124 deaths were related to the extreme heatwaves between late May and late August in France. Le Monde spoke to the friends and families of 11 of the victims to find out about the lives behind those numbers.

headline: French high school protests: 'Young people are not fooled by the discrimination and contempt that society directs at them'
description: Sociologist and child psychiatrist Laelia Benoit analyzes the discourse surrounding high school student protests through the lens of 'childism,' a term that refers to the set of prejudices against minors based on their age, which she introduced to France.
